fixture_migration.audit_command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
old=Path("docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2d1-before-post-script-timeout-fixture.py").read_bytes()
new=Path("tests/test_completion_event_authority.py").read_bytes()
assert old==subprocess.check_output(["git","show","070c38deb1f00f48e62c57c956d2dc0a938a1d76:tests/test_completion_event_authority.py"])
def nodes(raw):
    tree=ast.parse(raw)
    assertions=[ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Assert)]
    mocks=[ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr.startswith("assert_")]
    raises=[ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr=="raises"]
    return assertions,mocks,raises
a,b=nodes(old),nodes(new)
assert a==b
assert old.replace(b'"timeout": 0}',b'"timeout": 0.001}',1)==new
print({"old_sha256":hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),"new_sha256":hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest(),"assertions":len(a[0]),"mock_assertions":len(a[1]),"raises":len(a[2]),"unchanged":True})
PY

static_audit.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast, hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path(".")
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
rows = []
for p in sorted(root.glob("docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2d1-*.py")):
    raw=p.read_bytes()
    ast.parse(raw)
    assert raw and raw.endswith(b"\n")
    rows.append({"path":str(p),"sha256":sha(raw),"bytes":len(raw)})
baseline = [
 ("src/orze/engine/evaluator.py","before-evaluator"),
 ("src/orze/engine/native_post_script.py","before-native-post-script"),
 ("src/orze/engine/process_supervision.py","before-post-script-process-supervision"),
 ("tests/test_completion_event_authority.py","before-post-script-timeout-fixture"),
]
for source,label in baseline:
    raw = subprocess.check_output(["git","show","070c38deb1f00f48e62c57c956d2dc0a938a1d76:"+source])
    assert raw == (root/("docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2d1-"+label+".py")).read_bytes()
tests=[]
for filename in (
 "test_native_post_script_tree_completion.py", "test_post_script_launch_inputs.py",
 "test_post_script_skip_hold.py", "test_post_script_input_pinning.py",
 "test_post_script_supervision_binding.py", "test_post_script_process_identity.py",
 "test_post_script_ready_go.py",
):
    p=root/"tests"/filename
    raw=p.read_bytes()
    assertions=[ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(raw)) if isinstance(n,ast.Assert)]
    tests.append({"path":str(p),"sha256":sha(raw),"assert_count":len(assertions),
        "assert_ast_sha256":sha("\n".join(assertions).encode())})
print(json.dumps({"snapshots":rows,"baseline_byte_equal":len(baseline),"tests":tests},indent=2))
PY
static_audit.assert_ast_encoding: SHA256 of UTF8 newline-joined ast.dump(include_attributes=False) for ast.Assert nodes in ast.walk order, without a final newline.
